'''''Bofar''''' was a [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

The '''Bofar''' was at a makeshift base where prototypes of various [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] were being tested. However a single [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] was sent to destroy the TIE prototypes and managed to do so since none of the pilots were trained in proper combat. The freighter was a possible casualty of the skirmish as the Y-wing had enough time to destroy it.
